_comment: Home Repair — a TRADE module under Construction & Building Trades, not a core one. It opens with a single job done end to end (replacing a broken wall tile) rather than a survey of maintenance, because the whole difficulty of a repair in a finished building is the work you must NOT damage, and that only shows up when one job is followed all the way through. Built by ../lesson-kit/build.py.
_extraScripts: kit.js carries every step kind this module uses (lecture, label, safety, order, browse, questions, words); tiling.js is this module's own pictures and adds no renderer. A tiling page loads no carpentry file and no digital one.
hubIntro: Repairs in a finished building, done without making the damage worse. The module opens with wall tiling: taking a broken tile out of a wall that is already grouted and putting a new one back so that nobody can tell which one it was.
leadsNote: No Kenyan unit codes are claimed. The only national framework in this repo is the Carpentry & Joinery Level 4 one, and it says nothing about tiling — so every criterion here carries an empty leadsTo until a real tiling or building-maintenance framework is in hand. A claimed code that does not exist is worse than an honest blank.
endNote: You can plan a tile replacement, take the old one out without touching its neighbours and set the new one flush. What none of this gives you is the hand for it: the weight of the blow, the feel of a tile that is still holding, and whether the finished joint reads as a repair from a metre away. That is signed off at a wall, by an assessor, and nowhere else.
